root_cause.text: In the `iavf_config_rss_reg()` function within the iavf driver, the loop bounds for configuring RSS hash key and lookup table use an inclusive comparison operator (`<=`) against the calculated element count (`adapter->rss_{key,lut}_size / 4`), causing the loop to iterate one time beyond the allocated buffer limits.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies two loops in `drivers/net/ethernet/intel/iavf/iavf_main.c` by changing `i <= adapter->rss_key_size / 4` to `i < adapter->rss_key_size / 4` and `i <= adapter->rss_lut_size / 4` to `i < adapter->rss_lut_size / 4`; the CVE description confirms that `rss_{key,lut}_size / 4` represents the number of dwords where the last valid index is `(count - 1)`, so `<=` accesses one element past the end.
